30500.synonym: ṭha, ṭhaka, ṭhāyī, ṭhita, ṭhitika, tiṭṭhanta

examples.text: catukkhattuṃ pañcakkhattuṃ chakkhattu'paramaṃ tuṇhībhūto uddissa tiṭṭhamāno taṃ cīvaraṃ abhinipphādeyya, icc'etaṃ kusalaṃ, tato ce uttari vāyamamāno taṃ cīvaraṃ abhinipphādeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
dissat'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, cātumahābhūtiko kāyo ekam'pi vassaṃ tiṭṭhamāno dve'pi vassāni tiṭṭhamāno tīṇi'pi vassāni tiṭṭhamāno

30501.grammar: prp, masc nom sg of tiṭṭhanta, intrans

examples.text: ṭhitena kāyena ṭhitena cetasā, tiṭṭhaṃ nisinno uda vā sayāno, etaṃ satiṃ bhikkhu adhiṭṭhahāno, labhetha pubb'āpariyaṃ visesaṃ, laddhāna pubb'āpariyaṃ visesaṃ, adassanaṃ maccurājassa gacche'ti.
tiṭṭhañ'caraṃ, nisinno vā, sayāno vā, yāvat'assa vigatamiddho, etaṃ satiṃ adhiṭṭheyya, brahmam'etaṃ vihāraṃ idha'm'āhu.
etadeva paccayaṃ karitvā anaññan'ti na añño koci paccayo hoti upassutiṃ tiṭṭhituṃ.

30504.meaning1: should remain; should persist; should continue

examples.text: kayavikkaye na tiṭṭheyya, upavādaṃ bhikkhu na kareyya kuhiñci, gāme ca n'ābhisajjeyya, lābhakamyā janaṃ na lapayeyya.
yaṃ kiñci sampajānāsi, uddhaṃ adho tiriyañ'cā'pi majjhe, etesu nandiñ'ca nivesanañ'ca, panujja viññāṇaṃ bhave na tiṭṭhe.
tassā evam'assa, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ agatapubbañ'c'eva disaṃ gaccheyyaṃ, akhāditapubbāni ca tiṇāni khādeyyaṃ, apītapubbāni ca pānīyāni piveyyan'ti.
so tattha allāni c'eva tiṇāni pakkhipeyya, allāni ca gomayāni pakkhipeyya, allāni ca kaṭṭhāni pakkhipeyya, udakavātañ'ca dadeyya, paṃsukena ca okireyya.
tiṇadosāni khettāni, rāgadosā ayaṃ pajā, tasmā hi vītarāgesu, dinnaṃ hoti mahapphalaṃ.
evaṃ vutte, mahārāja, te bhikkhū maṃ etadavocuṃ, n'atthi kho, bhante, ghaṭikārassa kumbhakārassa nivesane tiṇaṃ, atthi ca khv'āssa āvesane tiṇacchadanan'ti.

30510.meaning1: grass and twigs; straw and sticks

examples.text: tiṇakaṭṭhasamaṃ lokaṃ, yadā paññāya passati, mamattaṃ so asaṃvindaṃ, n'atthi me'ti na socati.

30511.meaning1: living in the grass and wood

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso ādittaṃ tiṇ'ukkaṃ sukkhe tiṇadāye nikkhipeyya, no ce hatthehi ca pādehi ca khippam'eva nibbāpeyya. evañ'hi, bhikkhave, ye tiṇakaṭṭhanissitā pāṇā te anayabyasanaṃ āpajjeyyuṃ.

30512.meaning1: pile of dead grass, twigs, and leaves
30512.commentary: (VINa) tiṇakaṭṭhapaṇṇasaṭan'ti tattha tattha patitaṃ tiṇakaṭṭhapaṇṇaṃ. atha vā tiṇañ'ca nissārakaṃ lahukaṃ kaṭṭhañ'ca tiṇakaṭṭhaṃ. paṇṇasaṭan'ti purāṇapaṇṇaṃ.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma mahāvāto vāyanto tiṇakaṭṭhapaṇṇakasaṭaṃ ekato ussāreyya, seyyathā vā pana nadī pabbateyyā saṅkhasevālapaṇakaṃ ekato ussāreyya, evam'eva tumhe nānānāmā nānāgottā nānājaccā nānākulā pabbajitā ekato ussaritā.

30513.meaning1: pile of dead grass, twigs, and leaves
30513.commentary: (VINa) tiṇakaṭṭhapaṇṇasaṭan'ti tattha tattha patitaṃ tiṇakaṭṭhapaṇṇaṃ. atha vā tiṇañ'ca nissārakaṃ lahukaṃ kaṭṭhañ'ca tiṇakaṭṭhaṃ. paṇṇasaṭan'ti purāṇapaṇṇaṃ.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma mahāvāto vāyanto tiṇakaṭṭhapaṇṇasaṭaṃ ekato ussāreyya, seyyathā vā pana nadī pabbateyyā saṅkhasevālapaṇakaṃ ekato ussāreyya, evam'eva tumhe nānānāmā nānāgottā nānājaccā nānākulā pabbajitā ekato ussaritā.

30514.compound: dvanda (tiṇa ca kaṭṭha ca sākhā ca palāsa ca)

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso yaṃ imasmiṃ jambudīpe tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsaṃ tacchetvā ekajjhaṃ saṃhareyya, ekajjhaṃ saṃharitvā sūlaṃ kareyya
yaṃnūn'āhaṃ tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsaṃ saṃkaḍḍhitvā, kullaṃ bandhitvā, taṃ kullaṃ nissāya hatthehi ca pādehi ca vāyamamāno sotthinā pāraṃ uttareyyan'ti.

sace maṃ, bho gotama, evaṃ puccheyya, yo te ayaṃ purato aggi jalati ayaṃ aggi kiṃ paṭicca jalatī'ti, evaṃ puṭṭho ahaṃ, bho gotama, evaṃ byākareyyaṃ, yo me ayaṃ purato aggi jalati ayaṃ aggi tiṇakaṭṭh'upādānaṃ paṭicca jalatī'ti.

30517.compound: dvanda (tiṇa ca kaṭṭha ca udaka ca)
30517.commentary: (ANa) tiṇakaṭṭhodakan'ti hatthi-ass'ādīnaṃ ghās'atthāya gehānañ'ca chādanatthāya āharitvā bahūsu ṭhānesu ṭhapitatiṇañc'a, gehakaraṇapacan'ādīnaṃ atthāya āharitvā ṭhapitakaṭṭhañ'ca, yantehi pavesetvā pokkharaṇīsu ṭhapita-udakañ'ca.

examples.text: atha kho tesaṃ satthavāhānaṃ etadahosi, ayaṃ kho mahāsakaṭasattho sakaṭasahassaṃ, te mayaṃ yena yena gacchāma, khippam'eva pariyādiyati tiṇakaṭṭh'odakaṃ haritakapaṇṇaṃ. yaṃnūna mayaṃ imaṃ satthaṃ dvidhā vibhajeyyāma, ekato pañca sakaṭasatāni ekato pañca sakaṭasatānī'ti.

katamesaṃ catunnaṃ āhārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī? idha, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ tiṇakaṭṭh'odakaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.

30518.meaning1: pile of grass; bundle of straw

examples.text: sādhu me, bhante, ayyo mahako uttarimanussadhammaṃ iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ dassetū'ti. tena hi tvaṃ, gahapati, ālinde uttar'āsaṅgaṃ paññapetvā tiṇakalāpaṃ okāsehī'ti.

30520.meaning1: small grass hut; tiny straw house; (comm) even a seven story mansion thatched with grass

examples.text: tatiyam'pi kho āyasmato dhaniyassa kumbhakāraputtassa gāmaṃ piṇḍāya paviṭṭhassa tiṇahāriyo kaṭṭhahāriyo tiṇakuṭikaṃ bhinditvā tiṇañ'ca kaṭṭhañ'ca ādāya agamaṃsu.

kiṃ caritassa puggalassa kiṃ sappāyan'ti ettha pana sen'āsanaṃ tāva rāgacaritassa adhotavedikaṃ bhūmaṭṭhakaṃ akatapabbhārakaṃ tiṇakuṭikaṃ paṇṇasāl'ādīnaṃ aññataraṃ raj'okiṇṇaṃ jatukābharitaṃ oluggaviluggaṃ atiuccaṃ vā atinīcaṃ vā ujjaṅgalaṃ sāsaṅkaṃ asucivisamamaggaṃ
kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, mahācoro gahananissito hoti? idha, bhikkhave, mahācoro tiṇagahanaṃ vā nissito hoti, rukkhagahanaṃ vā rodhaṃ vā mahāvanasaṇḍaṃ vā.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yaṃ yadeva paccayaṃ paṭicca aggi jalati tena ten'eva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati… tiṇañ'ca paṭicca aggi jalati, tiṇ'aggitv'eva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati, gomayañ'ca paṭicca aggi jalati, gomay'aggitv'eva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati

30525.meaning1: edible grass and water; fodder and water
30525.commentary: (MNa) tiṇaghās'odakan'ti tiṇaghāsañ'c'eva udakañ'ca, tiṇaghāsan'ti ghāsitabbaṃ tiṇaṃ, khāditabban'ti attho.

examples.text: yato kho, aggivessana, āraññako nāgo hatthidamakassa yā sā vācā nelā kaṇṇasukhā pemanīyā hadayaṅ'gamā porī bahujanakantā bahujanamanāpā tathārūpāhi vācāhi samudācariyamāno sussūsati, sotaṃ odahati, aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhāpeti, tam'enaṃ hatthidamako uttari tiṇaghās'odakaṃ anuppavecchati.
n'atthi kho, bhante, ghaṭikārassa kumbhakārassa nivesane tiṇaṃ, atthi ca khv'āssa āvesane tiṇacchadanan'ti.

30527.meaning1: type of grass; species of grass

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, tathāgatassa arahato sammāsambuddhassa pubb'eva sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattass'eva sato tiriyā nāma tiṇajāti nābhiyā uggantvā nabhaṃ āhacca ṭhitā ahosi.
eragū, moragū, majjārū, jantū'ti imā catasso'pi tiṇajātiyo, etehi kaṭasārake ca taṭṭikāyo ca karonti.

30530.meaning1: wanting grass; in need of straw

examples.text: api c'āhaṃ, gāmaṇi, evaṃ vadāmi, tiṇaṃ tiṇ'atthikena pariyesitabbaṃ, dāru dāru'tthikena pariyesitabbaṃ, sakaṭaṃ sakaṭ'atthikena pariyesitabbaṃ, puriso puris'atthikena pariyesitabbo.

seyyathā'pi vā pana, nandiya, sukkhe tiṇadāye aggi mutto ḍahaññ'eva gacchati, no daḍḍhaṃ paccudāvattati, evam'evaṃ kho, nandiya, imehi ekādasahi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako pajahat'eva pāpake akusale dhamme, na upādiyatī'ti

30532.meaning1: ruined by weeds; spoiled by weeds

examples.text: tiṇadosāni khettāni, rāgadosā ayaṃ pajā, tasmā hi vītarāgesu, dinnaṃ hoti mahapphalaṃ.

āyatanānaṃ nānattadassanena pana ayaṃ appanā, ahi nām'esa bahi sittasammaṭṭhe ṭhāne n'ābhiramati, saṅkāraṭṭhāna-tiṇapaṇṇagahana-vammikāni'y'eva pana pavisitvā nipannakāle abhiramati, ek'aggataṃ āpajjati.

30534.meaning1: broken bits of grass, leaves and reeds

30535.meaning1: sound of grass, leaves and deer, etc.

30536.meaning1: pile of grass; heap of straw

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, issāso vā issās'antevāsī vā tiṇapurisarūpake vā mattikāpuñje vā yoggaṃ karitvā, so aparena samayena dūrepātī ca hoti akkhaṇavedhī ca mahato ca kāyassa padāletā.

so sākabhakkho'pi hoti sāmākabhakkho'pi hoti nīvārabhakkho'pi hoti daddulabhakkho'pi hoti haṭabhakkho'pi hoti kaṇabhakkho'pi hoti ācāmabhakkho'pi hoti piññākabhakkho'pi hoti tiṇabhakkho'pi hoti gomayabhakkho'pi hoti, vanamūlaphal'āhāro'pi yāpeti pavattaphalabhojī.
santi, bhikkhave, tiracchānagatā pāṇā tiṇabhakkhā. te allāni'pi tiṇāni sukkhāni'pi tiṇāni dant'ullehakaṃ khādanti.
bhisi nāma pañca bhisiyo, uṇṇabhisi, coḷabhisi, vākabhisi, tiṇabhisi, paṇṇabhisi.
migaluddo pure āsiṃ, araññe kānane ahaṃ, disvāna taṃ devadevaṃ, tiṇamuṭṭhiṃ adās'ahaṃ.
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kurūsu viharati kammāsadhammaṃ nāma kurūnaṃ nigamo, bhāradvājagottassa brāhmaṇassa agy'āgāre tiṇasantharake.

30545.commentary: (VINa) tiṇasanthāro'ti yesaṃ kesañci tiṇānaṃ santhāro. esa nayo paṇṇasanthāre

examples.text: seyyaṃ nāma bhisi, cimilikā uttar'attharaṇaṃ, bhūm'attharaṇaṃ, taṭṭikā, cammakhaṇḍo, nisīdanaṃ, paccattharaṇaṃ, tiṇasanthāro, paṇṇasanthāro.

30546.commentary: (ANa) tiṇasanthārako'ti tiṇehi vā paṇṇehi vā bhūmiyaṃ vā phalakapāsāṇatalāni vā aññatarasmiṃ santhatasanthato.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā kumbhakār'āvesanaṃ pavisitvā ekam'antaṃ tiṇasanthārakaṃ paññāpetvā nisīdi pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
evam'evaṃ te tiṇasanthārakasayan'āsanaṃ khāyissati santuṭṭhassa viharato ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa
idha, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo saṅgāmagato khamo hoti sattippahārānaṃ asippahārānaṃ usuppahārānaṃ pharasuppahārānaṃ bheripaṇavasaṅkhatiṇavaninnādasaddānaṃ. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo khantā hoti.

30549.meaning1: (vinaya) covering with grass; sweeping under the carpet
30549.commentary: (MNa) tiṇ'avatthārako'ti ettha idaṃ kammaṃ tiṇ'avatthārakasadisattā tiṇ'avatthārako'ti vuttaṃ. yathā hi gūthaṃ vā muttaṃ vā ghaṭṭiyamānaṃ duggandhatāya bādhati, tiṇehi avattharitvā suppaṭicchāditassa pan'assa so gandho na bādhati. (ANa) bhaṇḍan'ādi-vasena bahuṃ assāmaṇakaṃ katvā āpattiṃ āpannānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ ṭhapetvā thullavajjaṃ ṭhapetvā gihipaṭisaṃyuttañ'ca avases'āpattīnaṃ vūpasaman'atthāya tiṇ'avatthārako paññatto.

examples.text: uppann'uppannānaṃ adhikaraṇānaṃ samathāya vūpasamāya sammukhāvinayo dātabbo, sativinayo dātabbo, amūḷhavinayo dātabbo, paṭiññāya kāretabbaṃ, yebhuyyasikā, tassapāpiyasikā, tiṇ'avatthārako'ti.
yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ tiṇ'avatthārakena vūpasameyya, ṭhapetvā thullavajjaṃ, ṭhapetvā gihippaṭisaṃyuttan'ti.
yadā passāmi gopālakaṃ vā pasupālakaṃ vā tiṇahārakaṃ vā kaṭṭhahārakaṃ vā vanakammikaṃ vā, vanena vanaṃ gahanena gahanaṃ ninnena ninnaṃ thalena thalaṃ saṃpatāmi.

30552.commentary: (ANa) naḷ'āgārā'ti naḷehi channapaṭicchanna-agārā. sesasambhārā pan'ettha rukkhamayā honti. tiṇ'āgārepi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, naḷ'āgārā vā tiṇ'āgārā vā aggi mutto kūṭ'āgārāni'pi dahati ullitt'āvalittāni nivātāni phusit'aggaḷāni pihitavātapānāni, evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yāni kānici bhayāni uppajjanti sabbāni tāni bālato uppajjanti, no paṇḍitato

30553.meaning1: bundle of grass used as a torch

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, gahapati, puriso ādittaṃ tiṇ'ukkaṃ ādāya paṭivātaṃ gaccheyya.
maṃsapes'ūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo. tiṇ'ukk'ūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo.

30554.meaning1: like a grass torch; similar to a grass torch

examples.text: evam'eva kho, gahapati, ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati, tiṇ'ukk'ūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo'ti.
maṃsapes'ūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo. tiṇ'ukk'ūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo.
tesaṃ gimhānaṃ pacchime māse, tiṇ'odakasaṅkhaye, adhimattakasimānaṃ patto kāyo hoti.

30556.commentary: (ANa) ekissā vā tiṇ'odakadattiyā vimānito'ti ekadivasaṃ ekena tiṇ'odakadānena vimānito, ekadivasamattaṃ aladdhatiṇ'odako'ti attho.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo saṅgāmagato ekissā vā tiṇ'odakadattiyā vimānito dvīhi vā tīhi vā catūhi vā pañcahi vā tiṇ'odakadattīhi vimānito saṃsīdati visīdati, na santhambhati na sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otarituṃ. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo akkhamo hoti rasānaṃ.
tesaṃ gimhānaṃ pacchime māse, tiṇ'odakasaṅkhaye, adhimattakasimānaṃ patto kāyo hoti. tesaṃ adhimattakasimānaṃ pattakāyānaṃ balavīriyaṃ parihāyi.
cirassaṃ vata passāmi, brāhmaṇaṃ parinibbutaṃ, appatiṭṭhaṃ anāyūhaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ loke visattikan'ti.
sabbattha upekkhako satimā, na so hiṃsati kañci sabbaloke, tiṇṇo samaṇo anāvilo, ussadā yassa na santi sorato so.

30559.meaning1: who has crossed over; who has gone beyond
30559.meaning2: who has reached the final end

examples.text: yaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vedagum'ābhijaññā, akiñcanaṃ kāmabhave asattaṃ, addhā hi so ogham'imaṃ atāri, tiṇṇo ca pāraṃ akhilo akaṅkho.
yasmiṃ kāmā na vasanti, taṇhā yassa na vijjati, kathaṃkathā ca yo tiṇṇo, vimokkho tassa n'āparo.

30560.meaning1: free from doubt; gone beyond doubt

examples.text: yo nīvaraṇe pahāya pañca, anigho tiṇṇakathaṃkatho visallo, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇam'iva tacaṃ purāṇaṃ.

30561.meaning1: who has gone beyond weeping and wailing; who has overcome grief and mourning
30561.commentary: (DHPa) tiṇṇasokapariddave'ti atikkantasokapariddave, ime dve atikkante'ti attho. etehi pūj'ārahattaṃ dassitaṃ.

examples.text: pūj'ārahe pūjayato, buddhe yadi va sāvake, papañcasamatikkante, tiṇṇasokapariddave.

30562.commentary: (ANa) tiṇṇavicikiccho'ti vicikicchaṃ taritvā atikkamitvā ṭhito. (UDa) tattha paṭibhayakantārasadisā soḷasavatthukā ca aṭṭhavatthukā ca tiṇṇā vicikicchā etenā'ti tiṇṇavicikiccho.

examples.text: atha kho brahm'āyu brāhmaṇo diṭṭhadhammo pattadhammo viditadhammo pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṃkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthusāsane bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
vicikicchaṃ pahāya tiṇṇavicikiccho vihāsiṃ akathaṃkathī kusalesu dhammesu, vicikicchāya cittaṃ parisodhesiṃ.

30563.meaning1: fact of being beyond doubt; state without uncertainty
30563.construction:
tiṇṇa + vicikicchā + a + tā
tiṇṇavicikiccha + tā

examples.text: etam'ahaṃ, brāhmaṇa, tiṇṇavicikicchataṃ attani sampassamāno bhiyyo pallomam'āpādiṃ araññe vihārāya.
vicikicchissa purisapuggalassa tiṇṇavicikicchatā hoti parikkamanāya, kodhanassa purisapuggalassa akkodho hoti parikkamanāya, upanāhissa purisapuggalassa anupanāho hoti parikkamanāya

30565.grammar: card, masc & nt gen pl of ti

examples.text: yā kho, bhikkhave, imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ saṅgati sannipāto samavāyo, ayaṃ vuccati cakkhusamphasso. cakkhusamphasso'pi anicco vipariṇāmī aññathābhāvī.
attānañ'ce piyaṃ jaññā, rakkheyya naṃ surakkhitaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ aññataraṃ yāmaṃ, paṭijaggeyya paṇḍito.

30566.meaning1: who has crossed over; who has gone beyond

examples.text: yadā kho, āvuso, tassa purisassa evam'assa, saṃvissattho kho my'āyaṃ gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā'ti, atha naṃ rahogataṃ viditvā tiṇhena satthena jīvitā voropeyya.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso sār'atthiko sāragavesī sārapariyesanaṃ caramāno tiṇhaṃ kuṭhāriṃ ādāya vanaṃ paviseyya.
atha vetaraṇiṃ pana duggaṃ, tiṇhadhārakhuradhāram'upenti, tattha mandā papatanti, pāpakarā pāpāni karitvā.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, satti tiṇhaphalā. atha puriso āgaccheyya, ahaṃ imaṃ sattiṃ tiṇhaphalaṃ pāṇinā vā muṭṭhinā vā paṭileṇissāmi paṭikoṭṭissāmi paṭivaṭṭessāmī'ti.

30572.grammar: adj, in comps, from titikkhati, desid

examples.text: dukkaraṃ duttitikkhañ'ca, abyattena ca sāmaññaṃ, bahūhi tattha sambādhā, yattha bālo visīdatī'ti.
ahaṃ nāgo'va saṅgāme, cāpato patitaṃ saraṃ, ativākyaṃ titikkhissaṃ, dussīlo hi bahujjano.
yo have balavā santo, dubbalassa titikkhati, tam'āhu paramaṃ khantiṃ, niccaṃ khamati dubbalo.

30576.commentary: (DNa) titikkhā'ti khantiyā eva vevacanaṃ. titikkhā saṅkhātā adhivāsanakhanti uttamaṃ tapo'ti attho. (SNa) titikkhā'ti duruttānaṃ durāgatānaṃ vacanapathānaṃ adhivāsanakkhanti.

examples.text: jayaṃ ve maññati bālo, vācāya pharusaṃ bhaṇaṃ, jayañ'c'ev'assa taṃ hoti, yā titikkhā vijānato.
khantī paramaṃ tapo titikkhā, nibbānaṃ paramaṃ vadanti buddhā, na hi pabbajito par'ūpaghātī, na samaṇo hoti paraṃ viheṭhayanto.

30577.meaning2: armed with the shield of forbearance

examples.text: bhetvāna nāsaṃ atikassa rajjuṃ, nayiṃsu maṃ samparigayha luddā, etādisaṃ dukkham'ahaṃ titikkhaṃ, uposathaṃ appaṭikopayanto.

examples.text: yañ'ca jaññā kule jātaṃ, gabbhe tittaṃ amacchariṃ, tena sakhiñ'ca mittañ'ca, dhīro sandhātum'arahatī'ti.

30595.commentary: (ANa) paṭisevanāya n'atthi tittī'ti yathā yathā paṭisevati, tathā tathā ruccati'y'evā'ti titti nāma n'atthi. (THa) kāmehi lokamhi na h'atthi tittī'ti taṇhāvipannānaṃ imasmiṃ loke vatthukāmehi titti nāma n'atthi. (APt) tisa pīṇane'ti, titti.
